title: kumiko-headless is a deprecated shim over kumiko-renderer/headless
detail: The package only re-exports @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/headless and its subpaths and is removed after the consumer pass of wave 4.
migration: Import from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/headless, or run bun kumiko codemod package-merge . --write.

title: resolvePageHead gets preferredLocales (?lang= first, then Accept-Language by q) so resolvers can pick a content locale
detail: Callers constructing PageHeadResolveInput themselves must now pass preferredLocales (an empty array when no preference is known).

title: The timestamp FormatSpec takes an IANA timeZone
detail: { format: "timestamp", timeZone: "Europe/Berlin" } formats the instant in that zone instead of the runtime's zone. Without timeZone nothing changes. The option is ignored for the date format, which has no time component.

title: formatMoney and resolveSafeMoneyLocale move into headless
detail: formatMoney(amountMinor, currency, locale?, fractionDigits?) and resolveSafeMoneyLocale(locale) are exported from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-headless so server code such as the mail renderer formats money like the web client; renderer-web's formatMoney delegates to it.

title: Edit view model carries read-only cells and fixed rows
detail: EmbeddedListCellViewModel.readOnly and EditFieldViewModel.embeddedListFixedRows are derived from EditFieldSpec.embeddedList.

title: Embedded list cells carry the select display
detail: EmbeddedListCellViewModel.display is taken from the sub-field.

title: resolveNavigation no longer renders empty groups or entries that open nothing
detail: A nav node with no screen, target, provider, actions and createAction is dropped when none of its children is visible, also when it never had children. Allowlisted sidebars lose groups whose children are all filtered out. Give the entry a screen or keep a child visible to retain it.

title: Edit view model carries entityId and maxCount for file fields
detail: ComputeEditViewModelInput has an optional entityId (the record being edited, omitted on create). EditFieldViewModel gains entityId for file, image, files and images fields and maxCount for files and images. The file-field hints now also cover type files, which was missing.

title: Edit view-model carries selectOptionsAvailabilityQuery for multiSelect fields
refEntity no longer overrides a real non-text entity field on list columns and edit fields
Edit view-model carries selectOptionsAvailabilityQuery for select fields
Dates format with two-digit day and month
detail: `formatValue` for date values passes `day: "2-digit"` and `month: "2-digit"`, so German output is 01.10.2026 instead of 1.10.2026 in lists, details and related lists. List view models carry `hideOnNarrow` onto columns.
migration: Update tests and snapshots that expect single-digit day or month.

title: computeEditViewModel threads section.actions and EditRelatedListSection.emptyState into the view model (fw#3234)
detail: EditFieldsSectionViewModel, EditExtensionSectionViewModel, EditRelatedListSectionViewModel and EditWriteFormSectionViewModel all carry the spec's optional `actions` unchanged; EditRelatedListSectionViewModel's `emptyState.title`/`description` are translated the same way section.title already is.
migration: Additive — a view model without actions/emptyState in its spec is unaffected.

title: headless gains resolveAndInjectPageHead/injectPageHead for per-request head injection
detail: New apex exports: PageHeadMeta/PageHeadResolver/PageHeadSystemQuery types, injectPageHead (idempotent marker-based </head> splice), and resolveAndInjectPageHead (resolves a PageHeadResolver with a shared 300ms timeout, converts to ApexHead, renders via renderApexHeadTags, injects). Moved out of @cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime (kumiko-framework#3026) so runDevApp and runProdApp share one resolve+inject call instead of two copies of the timeout/fallback logic; server-runtime re-exports the three types unchanged for existing consumers.
